steps.title: Form your team
steps.description: Put together a team of three students. Teams can be interdisciplinary but every member must be a currently enrolled student at MIT-WPU.

steps.title: Register on the official ICPC portal
steps.description: Complete your team registration on the official ICPC portal. The link will be shared in the CoDeC Welcome Kit — check the Quick Facts section below.

steps.title: Pay the registration fee
steps.description: Submit the registration fee per the instructions on the portal. The exact amount will be confirmed and shared in the Welcome Kit.

steps.title: Confirm before the deadline
steps.description: Make sure your team's registration and payment are complete before the deadline. Dates will be announced by CoDeC and CDC.

steps.title: Prepare for the Preliminary Round
steps.description: Look out for prep sessions and practice resources shared by CoDeC and AlgoZenith to get your team ready for the online Preliminary Round.
